content.text: The Open Championship will take place at Royal Portrush from July 13 to July 20, 2025.
Feist: We've got a good run of opportunities, no one knows quite what's going to happen in the next two rounds (of the Championship).

Despite being the defending champion, Xander Schauffele acknowledges that his performance has not been great due to a rib injury he sustained at the beginning of the season, even though he ended up tied with Scheffler at nine-under par in last week's Scottish Open.
